# third_party

- `src/qrcodegen.hpp`, `src/qrcodegen.cpp` — QR Code generator library (C++) by
  Project Nayuki, MIT License. Copied unchanged from
  https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/tree/master/cpp ; the licence header
  at the top of each file is intact.

Arduino only compiles subfolders named `src`, hence the location.
